label: Старшина
description: A 10-sentence usage card for старшина (sergeant major).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Старшина' stays in the nominative as the subject. Though it ends in -а, it is a masculine animate noun, so 'наш' and 'строгий' take masculine forms.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate. 'Старшину' is the accusative direct object of 'уважают'. The first-declension ending -а becomes -у in the accusative, matching the feminine pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Старшины' takes the genitive to show whose order it was. The first-declension genitive singular ends in -ы.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Старшине' takes the dative after 'к', showing approach toward the person. The first-declension dative singular ends in -е.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Старшиной' takes the instrumental after 'со', meaning together with. The first-declension instrumental singular ends in -ой.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Старшине' takes the prepositional after 'о' to mean about the man. 'Новом' takes the masculine prepositional ending, confirming the noun's gender.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Старшины' is the nominative plural subject of 'служат'. 'Опытные' agrees in the plural, describing the experienced sergeants.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after numeral. 'Старшин' takes the zero-ending genitive plural required after 'двух' for an animate noun. The accusative animate equals the genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Старшина' is the nominative subject of 'дал'. 'Нам' is the dative recipient and 'задание' the accusative object of the giving.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Старшины' takes the genitive after 'без' to express absence. The first-declension genitive singular ends in -ы.
